parameters.query: SELECT c.id as client_id, c.client_code, c.company_name, c.status, c.plan_type, c.max_contacts, c.config, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE client_id = c.id) as current_contacts FROM clients c WHERE c.api_key = '{{ $json.api_key }}' AND c.status = 'active' LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO contacts (email, first_name, last_name, company, phone, job_title, source, tags, custom_fields, client_id) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.first_name || '' }}', '{{ $json.last_name || '' }}', '{{ $json.company || '' }}', '{{ $json.phone || '' }}', '{{ $json.job_title || '' }}', '{{ $json.source }}', ARRAY[{{ ($json.tags || []).map(t => "'" + t + "'").join(',') }}], '{{ JSON.stringify($json.custom_fields || {}) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.client_id }}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, company = EXCLUDED.company, phone = EXCLUDED.phone, client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING *

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, contact_id: $json.id, message: 'Contact synced' }) }}
